scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The automation design review
scenes.caption: Kabir compares a shared validated pipeline with a design that copies rules across screens and compares every record pair. The reviewer asks about correctness, efficiency, maintainability and what stays with a person.
scenes.dialogue: The fastest label is not the whole design.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Larger input and a changed rule
scenes.caption: The fresh brief has one hundred twenty eight records and a review threshold of at least eighty. The same all-pairs comparison requires eight thousand one hundred twenty eight pair checks; one record visit per item is one hundred twenty eight. Preparation and storage work still need stating.
scenes.dialogue: Count the operation and preserve the rule change history.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Revise in a separate version
scenes.caption: Evaluate the new rule on a preserved copy with a separate output ledger. Keep old-version results rather than overwriting them. Under the new brief, scores seventy nine, eighty and eighty one must follow the new inclusive boundary.
scenes.dialogue: A versioned check avoids confusing old and new decisions.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the design defence
scenes.caption: Should the team copy slightly different rules everywhere, choose a design only for its animation, or share validation and transformation, measure work and retain human ownership of conflicting data and policy?
scenes.dialogue: Correctness and oversight remain requirements at scale.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: An accountable design
scenes.caption: Kabir keeps the shared contracts, stable event IDs, quarantine and checkpointed retry. He reports the operation-count assumptions and names the authorised person who reviews conflicting identities or changes the priority policy.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the review lab
scenes.caption: Compare the two designs, test the new eighty-point rule and defend a fresh conflicting-record case. Use the schema, traces, counts and eight-case record in an individual teacher-reviewed viva.
scenes.dialogue: Defend the evidence and the remaining limit.
